text:
Anna P.: Quick q — Sam is being promoted from Sr SWE (IC-4) to Eng Manager (M1) starting 2025-04-01. Need to confirm: salary band mapping, equity refresh policy for manager promos, effective date & payroll proration, and whether we need manager interview scorecard for comp approval.
Mike L.: Congrats! For mapping, check Manager band M1 maps to salary band 6 (see paybands doc). Will they be moving into band 6 or staying in current comp band with a title change?
Anna P.: Hiring/manager said comp approved at midpoint of band 6. Equity: manager refresh guideline says first-time manager refresh ~5% of base — does that apply here?
Sara C.: @Anna P. yes, first-time manager refresh is standard practice; typically ~5% grant size or equivalent. We'll need the promotion rationale + team size in the evidence packet.
Jordan K.: Approval flow: manager -> director -> compops. Attach manager scorecard and promotion form. If we want effective 04/01 but payroll cutoff is 03/25 then submission needs to be in by 03/22 EOD to avoid retro.
Anna P.: Is there a template for the evidence packet?
Sara C.: Template (paste):
```
Promotion Evidence Form:
- Employee: Sam (sam@example.com)
- From role: Sr SWE (IC-4)
- To role: Eng Manager (M1)
- Effective date: 2025-04-01
- Approved base: $160,000
- Equity refresh request: 5% grant (justification attached)
- Manager scorecard: <link to scorecard>
- Team size / direct reports: 4
- Business justification: leading feature team + people management
```
Mike L.: Also check benefits impacts — health/401k stays the same, but manager-level equity may have different refresh cadence/vesting. @hr-bot any automated checks?
hr-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: promo comp changes must be submitted by 2025-03-22 23:59 UTC to take effect 2025-04-01 without retro. Retro pay requires a backpay calculation request; allow 2 pay cycles to process.
Sara C.: Note: if the equity request exceeds standard guidelines compops will escalate for exec signoff. Also confirm if this is a geographic band change (Sam is relocating to EU) — that affects salary band mapping and employment law checks.
Anna P.: Good point — Sam will remain in US payroll. Who runs the backpay calc if we miss cutoff?
Mike L.: Payroll + CompOps handle backpay. CompOps needs the signed approval + promo form; Payroll needs the effective date and final salary. I'll create the compops ticket once form uploaded.
Jordan K.: I'll review the scorecard and the manager rubric today. @Anna P. ping me when the form is attached.
Anna P.: Uploaded evidence + signed manager scorecard here: <link-to-drive>. Submitted compops ticket #COPS-4521. Thanks all! :tada:
Sara C.: Received. I'll triage the compops ticket and flag if exec signoff needed. Expect an update by EOD tomorrow.
Mike L.: Adding note — check 1) equity grant date (next grant window vs immediate), 2) any sign-on or retention that affects equity cap.
Anna P.: Awesome, appreciate it. Will follow up if payroll asks for anything else. :thumbsup:
